title: Workflow inventory
description: The Temporal workflow types and activity interfaces that one commit of a repository declares.

commit.description: Commit of the analysed repository the inventory was produced from.

modelMode.description: How the source model was obtained.

workflows.description: Workflow types, ordered by workflow type and then by interface.

modulePath.description: Path of a module of the analysed repository.

file.description: Path relative to the root of the analysed repository, with / separators.

name.description: Workflow type, signal, query or update name as registered with Temporal. An update validator carries the name of its update.

class.description: Fully qualified name of the implementing class.

additionalEntryPoints.description: Handlers the class registers through workflow interfaces other than the one that names the workflow type and its supertypes.

workflowType.description: Workflow type name as registered with Temporal. A class that implements the SDK's DynamicWorkflow runs for every workflow type without an implementation of its own and has no such name: it is listed as 'dynamic-' followed by its simple name, with the SDK's interface as its interface.

interface.description: Fully qualified name of the workflow interface.

module.description: Module that declares the interface. Absent if the interface comes from a library.

loc.description: Where the interface is declared. Absent if the interface comes from a library.

entryPoints.description: The workflow method first, then signals, queries, updates and update validators, each ordered by name.

implementations.description: Classes that implement the interface, ordered by name.

interface.description: Fully qualified name of the activity interface.

module.description: Module that declares the interface, in Kotlin or in Java. Absent if the interface comes from a library.

loc.description: Where the interface is declared. Absent if the interface comes from a library.

namePrefix.description: Prefix of the interface's default activity type names.

activities.description: The activity types the interface registers, ordered by name.

name.description: Activity type name as registered with Temporal.

implementations.description: Classes that implement the interface, ordered by name.
